tasks.label: EXR005 writer focused verification
args: $result = Invoke-Pester -Path 'samples/contoso-exchange-online-managed-service/tests/unit/ExchangeLiveAdapters.Tests.ps1' -PassThru -Output Detailed; Write-Output ('EXR005-WRITER Total={0} Passed={1} Failed={2}' -f $result.TotalCount,$result.PassedCount,$result.FailedCount); if ($result.FailedCount) { exit 1 }

tasks.label: EXR005 writer full regression
tasks.command: & { $result = Invoke-Pester -Path 'samples/contoso-exchange-online-managed-service/tests' -Output None -PassThru; Write-Output ('EXR005 FULL Total={0} Passed={1} Failed={2} Skipped={3} NotRun={4} FailedContainers={5}' -f $result.TotalCount,$result.PassedCount,$result.FailedCount,$result.SkippedCount,$result.NotRunCount,$result.FailedContainersCount); foreach ($failure in $result.Failed) { Write-Output ('FAIL: {0}: {1}' -f $failure.ExpandedPath,$failure.ErrorRecord.Exception.Message) }; if ($result.FailedCount -or $result.FailedContainersCount) { exit 1 } }
